batting.name: JH Kallis
batting.dismissal: c TL Suman b JEC Franklin

batting.name: YK Pathan
batting.dismissal: c AN Ahmed b JEC Franklin

batting.name: TL Suman
batting.dismissal: c YK Pathan b Iqbal Abdulla

batting.name: SR Tendulkar
batting.dismissal: c G Gambhir b R Bhatia

batting.name: RG Sharma
batting.dismissal: c SP Goswami b R Bhatia

balls.text: short and wide, tries to slash that past point, missed, Shakib tried to steal a bye, there was confusion out in the middle and Rayudu ran in to take off the bails
four more, slipped in the slower one this time, short it was and he slapped it over the non-striker's head to beat long-on to the boundary
sweetly hit, pitched up outside off and Bhatia smoked it past the outstretched hands of Abu Nechim to beat mid-off to the boundary
full toss outside off, slashed straight to third man for a single
walked across to flick that straight delivery over midwicket, missed and was caught plumb in front of middle and leg
in the blockhole outside off, ten Doeschate had given himself room, couldn't make contact
was shaping up to paddle it fine, slightly short on middle, got across and dabbed it into the leg side for a single
gets it right this time, slower one on middle and he flicked it over midwicket, nicely done, off the meat and cleared the ropes
didn't pick the slower one, was into the shot too early, miscued it completely and Malinga got under it, only to drop it, straight through his fingers, what a mess
full on middle, digs it out into the leg side behind square leg for a single
short and slow, dabs it into the off side, searches for a single but Rayudu prevents it
short of a good length, jabs that in front of point for a single
drops it into the leg side, a vacant leg-side field, and by the time Pollard runs in from deep midwicket to cut that off they've already run two, well done
nicely done, moved across too early and Franklin slid that down the leg side, ten Doeschate did well to get some bat on that one to clip it to the fine-leg boundary
angling it on middle, turned towards short fine leg for a single

gone this time, wasn't quite the right length, good length and he tried to strike him over extra cover, got an outside edge instead and it landed safe into the palms of point, the end of a good innings, Kolkata have a challenging score already
over the off, slower one bowled full and he lofted it clean over the extra-cover boundary, stylish shot
Kallis marches to a fifty in style, dropped it short did Franklin and he was ready for it, smashed it flat over midwicket
comes down the track and drops it on the pitch, Harbhajan gives him the stare
fires it down the leg side, Rayudu does well diving full length to his left to get a glove to that
drops it into the leg side, wisely, to pick a single
ten Doeschate survives, came down the track to another doosra, tried to smash that over midwicket, didn't pick it again, got a leading edge that landed in no man's land
punched past cover for a comfortable single this time
Kallis sends it into the stands, quicker one bowled flat on the off, he bent low and slog-swept it over cow-corner
the doosra first up to ten Doeschate, he doesn't pick it, gets a leading edge wide of point, gives Kallis the strike
slower one on middle and Yusuf had made his mind up, bent low and tried to whip it over square leg, was a bit of a miscue, Abu Nechim was placed at deep square leg and judged it well
good length on middle, cramped him for space there, he could only play it back to the bowler
Kallis makes room and gets a thick inside edge as he tries to drive that full delivery past extra cover
length again with more pace, played it hard past the bowler to long-off
in the slot but he missed as it cut away, it seemed like he had picked the slower one and tried to dispatch it over long-on but it was the legcutter to the right hander, it cut away
cracked it towards deep cover on the up for a single
slung it on middle, driven down to long-on for a single to keep strike
slower one bowled on a good length, cracked down to long-on for a single
compensates for that with a powerful drill past extra cover, was pitched up and he ensured he didn't waste it
full toss on leg stump, Yusuf will feel he missed out there, whipped it straight to short fine leg
short of a good length, punched down the ground to long-off for one more
slower one bowled full, drags it awkwardly to long-on for a single
slower one bowled short on the off, punched past extra cover for a single
driven nicely on the up down the ground to long-off
pitched up on the off, lofted it over extra cover wide of long-off for a couple of runs
punched it down the ground to long-on for a single
short outside off, was the slower one, Yusuf was aiming to chop it past point, got it much finer than that, played it wide of the diving Rayudu to beat short third man
landed on a length and Yusuf struck it well but straight to extra cover
a superb yorker again and Yusuf perhaps was anticipating that, dug it out into the off side for another single
nice yorker, swung in and Kallis got his bat down just in time, got an inside edge onto his pads and it popped up, a quick single in the end
short ball outside off but was the slower one that Kallis didn't pick, swung at it too early and missed
shortish on the off, punched straight to Pollard at point
slinging it on middle, pushed down to long-on for a single
short of a good length, knocks it down in front of point and races down to the other end
shortish on middle, knocked it down wide of short fine for a single, raises the 100, Kolkata shaping up well for the surge
pushed it down towards long-on for a single
pushed it back towards the bowler, slightly short on middle
shortish on leg stump, tries to fend it fine, clips the pads on the way to the keeper, Rayudu does a good job diving to his left
turned away wide of Sachin at short fine leg for a quick single, a missed run-out in the end, had Sachin aimed accurately at the striker's end Yusuf was gone
drops it short on middle, pulls it to deep midwicket for a single
Kallis jumps in, short of a good length and he rocked back to crack it hard past point for another four, Kolkata have wrested the initiative once again from Mumbai
punched it in front of point to steal one more
driven on the up towards deep cover for one more
short of a good length, slaps it wide of deep cover for a single
beautifully placed, third man was brought up and he picked the gap perfectly, short outside off and he just chops that into the gap
Yusuf's looking dangerous, short and wide, food and drink and he slashes it hard over point
tossed up on the off, moves away and Yusuf cashes in, lofting it over extra cover for a boundary, Price hasn't had the best start to the IPL
shortish on the off, punched it wide of extra cover for a single
Yusuf's sent that into orbit, the slog-sweep, on middle and he swings it away miles into the stands behind deep square leg
drops it into the off side in front of point and races away
on the back foot, works it away past midwicket for a single
angles in towards middle, gets forward and drops it into the leg side
short of a good length, runs it down to third man for a single

appeal for run-out, Tiwary runs that down to short third man where Harbhajan does a superb, collects and fires a venomous throw onto the stumps at the striker's end, Tiwary is caught short, a threatening innings cut short
good length and he smacked it on the up through to deep cover for a single, raises his bat, wants it changed
slightly short on middle and leg, turned it straight to short fine, was looking to get it past him
Tiwary's doing a splendid job, deft touches more than powerplay, slower one and he's just opened the face to ease it past short third man
slightly short on the off, turned past midwicket for a single
dropped it behind point for a single to keep the strike
quicker through the air, jumped down the track and knocked it wide of midwicket for a single
nice placement, waited for it to turn in, made room early and guided it past point and it raced away on this quick outfield
gets forward and pushes it straight to midwicket
gets front and across and drives it past midwicket for a single
flights on middle, Tiwary reverse-paddles it down to short third man
nicely pulled but there is cover in the deep, pulled away to deep midwicket for a single
pushed it off the front foot towards deep cover for a single
tossed up on leg, comes down and turns it past midwicket
short on leg stump, worked away past square leg for a single
Tiwary gave him the charge again but Price fired it flat on middle and leg, turned past midwicket for one more
turned off the front foot past midwicket for a single
good length on the off, pushed it wide of cover for an easy single
slower one again, this time on leg stump, tickled straight to short fine
slower one bowled short outside off, run down to third man for a single
good stuff, banged it in this time and with pace, Tiwary had stepped down the track but ended up having to duck
deceived by the slower ball, change of pace and Tiwary was committed to an attempt to clear midwicket, missed it completely
angled in towards leg stump, tapped it into the on side for a quick single, Tiwary's looking good
not the best start for Price, Tiwary's playing him well, kept it flat this time but Tiwary had made up his mind, charged down the track and launched it high and handsome over long-on
bowled it flat on the off, defended towards extra cover
flighted, comes down the track and drives it down to long-off for a single
angled in towards middle, Tiwary didn't strike that well but had enough on it, clipped that one behind short fine leg and it raced away
tossed up on the off from round the wicket, driven down the ground to long-off
short of a good length on the off, played away towards point
nicely done once again, short of a length outside off, the ropes are pulled in and as he just ran it past the keeper by opening the face, third man had no way to reach that one
fished for it outside off, held it back slightly and pushed it outside off, Tiwary poked at it and missed
nicely timed, was full on the off, Tiwary moved across to drive it past a diving midwicket for a boundary, just turned the face and off it went
it flies to the third man fence... but off the off stump! It was a straight length deivery, but for some Gambhir tried to play it wide of mid-on, and thus across the line. Missed it altogether
and Gambhir gives him a whack, makes room and upper-cuts this short ball over point for a six
tries to improvise, tossed up and he made room, it landed full and he just sliced it over point for a boundary
shoritsh on the off, gets on the back foot to punch it to cover
turned away past midwicket for a single
comes down the track this time, and Harbhajan chases him, tries to work it away through midwicket, struck on the pads, a couple of leg byes behind point
short of a good length on middle, went straight on, no room there, Gambhir had to create it, moved away and chopped it to point
angles in towards leg stump, gets forward and defends it on the leg side
in the slot for Kallis and he opens up, picked it from a length and dispatched it over extra cover for a boundary
off the mark straightaway, short of a good length, drops it wide of cover for a quick single

run-out, Goswami goes, full on leg stump, pushed straight to mid-off, Goswami was ball-watching as Kallis ran past him, no communication between the two, Goswami had crossed Kallis as the throw landed in front of the keeper, massive mess
fullish around leg stump, turned the face to play it wide of square leg for a single
slides down the leg side, called a wide
lovely yorker, he had no answer to that one, just landed outside off and he failed to get his bat down in time, sped past him
fires it full outside off and Kallis chases that one, drives at it, misses as it moves away a little, the keeper fumbles
slides on the pads, clipped towards short fine leg, straight to the fielder
a bit more pace on that one, shortish on middle, Kallis fends it behind square to get off the mark
full toss on middle, driven straight to mid-on
tight line, around a good length on the off this time, pushed away towards cover
back of a length on the off, defends it towards cover
short of a good length on the off, Kallis watches it closely onto his bat and knocks it into the off side
A Javed Miandad moment! Full toss on middle and Ambati Rayudu swings it over deep square leg for a six to seal a thriller
low full toss and it's driven straight to extra cover, just the single
Streaky, streaky, streaky, three such boundaries this over, full toss outside off, its off the outside edge again to the third-man boundary, was targeting extra cover, oh Franklin
Franklin's turning it on, full toss outside off and he creams that past extra cover to beat the diving fielder in the deep
four more, this game is very much alive, dropped it short on middle and Franklin went for the pull, went off the top edge and over the keeper's head
boundary first ball, streaky, full toss and Franklin gets an outside edge as he tries to smack that through cover, he'll take it

two more, Rayudu tried to shuffle and flick that over short fine leg, clipped the pads and they stole a leg bye, Gambhir is upset at Goswami as he conceded another run with a direct hit, a needless one, at the striker's end
misfield, bad bounce for the fielder at point, low full toss, played it towards point but the ball spun away from Gambhir there, two more
Rayudu gave him the charge and ended up slicing it over point for a couple of runs, Gambhir throws in a hard one and is holding his shoulder in pain
full outside off again, driven straight to deep extra cover for a single
full on the off, driven wide of Kallis at deep cover for a couple, he fumbles
not a wide though Franklin hoped for one, full outside off and just inside that line, Franklin regrets letting it go
Rayudu clears the ropes, a timely strike, full outside off and he launches that one over the deep extra cover boundary
full toss down the leg side, called a wide
smacked down towards long-on for a single, was a long-on
slashed past point for a single, a slower one bowled short
Bowled'im! full on leg stump, he made room to smack it over long-on, missed and out went the leg stump towards the keeper, lovely sight for Balaji
aiming for the yorker, is full on the off, digs it out wide of the bowler to long-on for a single
Franklin finds the boundary, full and wide and he moves away to slice it over point
pitched up but Franklin can only manage a single, drives it hard but on the bounce to deep extra cover, just the one
was shaping up for a scoop but Lee smartly delivered a yorker outside off, could only manage a single
not a wide this time, was well within the line, full again and Pollard couldn't quite reach it
called a wide again, full and wide, very close to that line again and Taufel calls it
full toss that Franklin will be disappointed not to dispatch, struck straight to deep cover
full and wide, called it, was a marginal call that Brett Lee is upset about, very close to that line
full on the off, crunched past extra cover for a well-run couple
Balaji does well in the deep, was a full toss and Franklin steered it wide of point, Balaji, running from third man, cut it off with a full length dive
struck hard, tossed up outside off, moved across and swept it cleanly past square leg for a boundary
Pollard was targeting long-on again, flatter delivery that turned away and Pollard missed it
chops this wide of cover for a single
Franklin steps up, charged down the track, gave it a bit of air did the bowler and he smashed it over long-on
short on the off, pulled hard but to long-on, gets to him on the bounce
quicker one on the off, pushed down to long-on for a single
fullish on middle, Pollard defends it back to the bowler
comes down the track and drags that down to long-on for a single
the legcutter again, gets forward and drops it into the off side for a single
Pollard squeezes that through, full outside off, makes room and slices it over point for four
slower one bowled short outside off, cut towards short third for a single
fullish on leg stump, chipped towards deep midwicket for a single
drilled hard to long-off for a single, tidy stuff from Shakib
quicker through the air, slapped straight to extra cover
gets across to turn it behind square for a single
flighted, comes down the track and drives it wide of midwicket, Pollard calls for the second and makes it back with a dive
slightly short on the off, punched past extra-cover for a single
Pollard gets forward and plays it wide of slip
good length on the off, knocks it back to the bowler
targeting middle and leg, pushed away into the leg side for a single
fullish on the off, pushed straight to extra cover

Bhatia's on a roll, Mumbai in trouble here, the slower legcutter again, Tendulkar made room to loft that over extra cover but ended up slicing it to Gambhir who pedalled back from point to take a neat catch
just chips that over the bowler's head for one more
bowled on a length and Tendulkar lofts it on the bounce to long-on for a single
full toss on the off, Tendulkar drives it down to long-off for a single to keep strike
gets on the back foot and punches it down to long-off for a single
looping it on middle, gets forward and opens the face to play it wide of slip where Yusuf does well diving to his right
dabs it off the front foot towards point
fired it quick outside off, turned away sharply and Pollard poked at it only to be beaten
swept it down to deep square leg for a single
Tendulkar picks the slower one, moves across and sweeps it uppishly past square leg, had eyed that gap and executed the shot perfectly
the slower legcutter, short of a good length on the off, defends it into the off side
sliding on leg stump, turns it away to fine ;eg for a single

caught-behind, Bhatia is hurting Mumbai here, slower one bowled short outside off, Rohit slashed it hard, got a thick edge that was snapped up by Goswami on the second attempt, the tide seems to be turning
driven down to long-on for a single
quicker through the air, bowled short on middle, pulled away to deep square leg for a single
called wide, tossed up and spun away but too wide this time and was called
slightly short outside off, cut just wide of point for a single
sweeps it past square leg for a couple of runs, helped by a fumble by the fielder running in from the deep
gets forward and defends it back to the bowler
he doesn't need that mich width, short on the off, turned away again, cut it hard between point and short third
tossed it up outside off, Rohit let it go as it turned away and was hoping for a wide but it wasn't called
slower one bowled short on the off, punched past the bowler for a quick single, nice little over from Bhatia, coming in after a blow to his head
slower one bowled full on the off, dragged down to long-on for one more
good length on middle, driven down towards long-on for one more
slower one on leg stump, turned past square leg for a single
short of a good length, punched back to the bowler, Bhatia fumbles on his follow through and they steal a single
he's holed out, short of a good length and Bhajji tried to slap that over long-on, didn't connect it well and found Manoj Tiwary in the deep
slightly short, paddled on the bounce to short fine leg
bowled it flat on the off, came down the track and smacked it to deep midwicket
flighted on middle, driven down to long-on for a single
cheekily done, had shaped up to play the sweep but it landed wide and he adjusted beautifully to open the face and guide it past Gautam Gambhir at short third man for a boundary, lovely stuff
the leg-side field is spread out for Bhajji who slogs it towards deep midwicket
tossed it up on the off, swept it straight to square leg
ooh, the wide ball there proving costly, Tendulkar fetched him from outside off to sweep that hard past midwicket, Mumbai making good progress after that early loss
fired that one down the leg side, called a wide, the keeper fumbled to concede one more
floated it on the off stump, Harbhajan just got his bat down in time to chop it in front of point
moved back to pull that past midwicket, got an inside dege onto his pads, hurried onto him a little
waits for it to turn away and punches it towards deep cover for a single
short on leg stump, jabs it past square leg for a single
eased past extra cover into the deep for a single
a couple more, short of a good length, cross-batted it past midwicket, Lee ran across to cut that off, a productive over for Mumbai
leaking runs this over, leg-byes but poor line from Balaji, low full toss on leg stump and Harbhajan just had to get something on it

dropped, Bhatia falls on his head, was bowled on a length, tried to smash him over mid-on but just managed to get it past him in the end, Bhatia was pedalling back and misjudged it, hit the ground hard did Bhatia, with his head on top of that, he's in some pain and the physio's out
didn't get hold of that one, short ball, a slower one outside off, Harbhajan slaps it and just manages to evade the in-field on the off side, a couple more
struck cleanly over the bowler's head, full on middle, he got under it and smacked it for a one bounce four
full and wide, swung away further, called a wide
strays on leg stump, Tendulkar tried to glance him fine but wasn't able to, a leg bye in the end
mighty swing from Harbhajan, short on middle and he tries to pull it over midwicket, was much slower than he expected, swung too early but got an inside edge on the thigh
floats it on middle, gets across to tap it wide of square leg for a single
gets on the back foot and chips it wide of mid-on for a single, Lee covers it in the end, uppish but safe
shortish on the off, slower through the air, moves back and swats it to the bowler
shortish on the off and turned away, Harbhajan stepped out but adjusted well in the end to tap it to extra cover
flighted on the off, makes room and drives it to extra cover
four more for Bhajji, tossed up, bowled full on middle, lofts it over the bowler's head for a one bounce four, Mumbai seemingly on track
tossed up outside off, turned away as he tried to slog it over midwicket, missed
flighted on the off, pushed it back towards the bowler
shortish on the off, turning away, punched to extra cover
tossed up on the off, driven through the line to long-off for a single
Tendulkar paddles that fine, shuffled a bit and picked it from middle to beat short fine leg
banged in short outside off, goes for the pull but misses out, doesn't connect
goodish length on the off, pushed towards point
short of a good length on leg stump, moved across to help it fine again, got a bit of bat on that but then onto the pad
misses out there, short, swiveled to help it to the fine leg boundary, got struck on the pads
meanwhile, Lee bangs it short and Harbhajan pulls it over square leg for a boundary, got into position early
Harbhajan plays that well, Lee bowls it full on the pads and he flicks it sweetly over midwicket

appeal for lbw, a huge one, went straight on, landed on middle and leg and held its line as Tendulkar closed the face on it, did he get an inside edge? Because if he didn't, that looked out. Was struck on the pads and the umpire didn't give it out. We'll know better once we see the replay.
good length on middle, gets across to turn it square for a single
Harbhajan sweeps at that wildly,but it turns away once again to beat the swing of the bat
appeal for caught-behind, there was a deflection, turned away after landing on a good length, Harbhajan was beaten and it flicked the back pad on the way to the keeper
held it back slightly, turned away and he played inside the line to that one
strikes immediately! Suman charged out to dispatch him over midwicket first ball, it turned away and he ended up getting a leading edge, Yusuf took it easily at extra cover
found the gap, banged in short on middle and Tendulkar got into position early to pull it between square leg and midwicket, was uppish but well into the gap
what a shot! Good length and he rose up to just punch that through extra cover, did that to Wasim Akram in the 2003 World Cup
good length on middle, a hint of away swing, pushed straight to mid-on

short of a good length on leg stump, tries to whip it square, struck high on the pads and Lee lets out an uncertain appeal, struck him on the thigh actually, get a run off a ricochet after the stumps at the striker's end are struck
full outside off, gets it to swing away, T Suman chases that but it just escapes the outside edge
Mumbai begin well, short of a length on middle, T Suman gets back and whips it down to the fine-leg boundary
